Meta.description: Per-call transport metadata. Identity is never accepted here.

project.description: Project scope; defaults from the principal or server.

idempotencyKey.description: At least 128 bits of caller or SDK randomness for writes.

agent.description: Unverified client label used only to scope anonymous leases and idempotency.

Ref.description: Canonical wire reference. Exactly one of id or key is present; branch is valid only with id.

Filter.description: Parent selects transitive descendants for ready and direct children for the snapshot list, before pagination. The separate opt-in epic-progress view uses exactly query=parent=<bare branch-zero bead ID> with no additional query clauses, resources, types or events; it selects canonical direct children only, across their own projects.

parent.description: Transitive descendants of this branch-zero bead ID, excluding the root; applied before pagination.

priority.description: Exact priority intersected with the other membership filters before pagination.

viewId.description: View membership for subscriptions and watches.

includeEphemeral.description: Include live ephemeral workflow items; defaults to true for backward-compatible ready reads.

parent.description: Canonical direct parent ID when readable; an unreadable parent is exactly {exists:true} with no identity, project, status or content. Root beads omit parent. Requests and storage retain canonical Ref values.

targetStatus.description: Exact declared nonterminal status for this project/type; omission selects the workflow initial status. Noninitial targets require an allowed transition from initial and all its guards. Terminal loading uses create followed by guarded close.

metadata.description: Typed predicates apply only to waits-for; opaque nativeExtensions apply to every kind. Omission preserves existing metadata on re-add; explicit {} selects all-children without also_blocks.

comments.description: Optional imported or legacy comments. Existing bead.get authorization and as-of semantics apply.

ViewDefinition.description: The trusted epic-progress capability admits groupBy=["epic-progress"], explicitly present fields=[], and exactly filter.query="parent=<bare bead ID>". No sort or additional filters are admitted. budgetTokens must be absent or zero: this complete count is not token-budgeted or paged. The ordinary authorized input cap is 20,000, never the 100,000 type-summary exception; at most 100 groups including total are returned. Refusals return no partial counts.

elided.description: An output bound. Epic progress reports hidden direct children only on the total group: count is the exact hidden remainder and reason is authorization. Render the literal “N more you can’t see”; never infer hidden statuses. Its required continueWith refreshes the same authorized request without cursor/asOf and cannot reveal or page hidden children. Ordinary output_budget elision retains its signed continuation semantics.

groups.description: Existing grouped output. Epic progress returns key=total with the visible direct-child count and status:<canonical status ID> groups counting visible children only; every items array is empty. Keys identify statuses in the ontology read from the same asOf content snapshot; they do not infer labels, readiness or completion policy. Only total may carry authorization elision. MaxGroups=100 includes total; incomplete or over-limit results refuse without truncation.

count.description: Exact authorized ordinary predicate total, present including zero only for countOnly=true. Items is empty; groups, elisions and nextCursor are absent. The ordinary 20,000 authorized-candidate cap applies; overflow refuses scope_too_large without a partial count.

Changeset.x-event-order: Absent events means legacy ChangeRecord indexes. Present events is the complete atomic plan. No partial plans, empty plans, synthetic dependent changes, or truncation. Public resume tuple remains incarnation/revision/index; projections consume the complete revision.

HumanPresence.description: D32 proof bound to the method and plan/archive digest. API keys and iframe or other-origin bearer calls cannot satisfy interactive_session.

WarningCode.description: Closed subset of error codes permitted in result.warnings.

StoreRestoredDetails.description: Restore crossed the incarnation boundary; the envelope carries the new incarnation.

ConditionUnmetDetails.x-validation: Refs must match the directed edge; edge revision equals dependent image revision; blocker before/after refs match and revisions differ; status changes. Resolved decisions use the pinned blocker-own-project ontology, never live interpretation. Blocker-after must be strictly later than blocker-before; dependent and ontology source revisions cannot be later than blocker-after.

DependencyConditionUnmetEvent.x-validation: resource is bead/<dependent ID>; revision equals blockerAfter.revision. No mutation of the dependent is implied. Current read authorization and redaction cover dependent, blocker, ontology and optional blocker project; suppress the entire notice on any denial.

EventDescriptor.x-validation: Index equals array position. Exactly one ordinary event for every ChangeRecord in ChangeIndex order, followed immediately by notices sorted uniquely by dependent ID. Notices retain ordinary close/cancel slot event and identical provenance, anchor the changed blocker and from/current revisions. Chain matches the changeset header. Event/resource kind, operation and slot must agree.

DisplayNameInput.description: Optional caller-asserted, untrusted display-only label. Trim leading and trailing Unicode White_Space; reject Unicode control (Cc) and format (Cf) characters with typed invalid_params. Allow at most 64 Unicode scalar values after trimming, not bytes or grapheme clusters; empty after trimming means absent. The raw input schema intentionally has no maxLength because padding is removed before applying the bound. Normalization and category rejection require the later consumer; schema validation alone does not perform them. Never use displayName for authorization, attribution, audit actor, idempotency, leases or dedup. Render it next to the authenticated principal (user name, API key name, or anonymous), never instead of or as that principal.

DisplayName.description: Optional normalized, untrusted display-only label from session.open. Omit when empty after trimming Unicode White_Space; otherwise 1..64 Unicode scalar values, with no control (Cc) or format (Cf) characters. Trimming and category rejection are normative consumer requirements. Never use it for authorization, attribution, audit actor, idempotency, leases or dedup. Always render it next to the authenticated principal (user name, API key name, or anonymous); never replace or impersonate the principal. Keep two sessions of one principal as distinct members by sessionId, each with its own displayName; do not merge their labels into a trusted group identity.

Comment.description: Stored comment. Legacy comments retain body, principal and time. Imported comments add a verified restoring principal, fixed import origin, restore commit time and separate source provenance.

id.description: Stable one-based position in the append-only stored thread.

CommentPageSelection.description: Select one comment page. The default limit is 100 and the maximum is 500; a cursor resumes the pinned thread.

CommentPage.description: One pinned comment thread page in (time, stored ordinal) order. An absent nextCursor marks the end.

LegacyComment.description: Pre-import stored comment shape. It is decoded unchanged for backward compatibility.

principal.description: Verified restoring actor supplied by the trusted import admission; never sourceAuthor.

time.description: Restore commit time, not the source comment time.

sourceTime.description: Original source timestamp retained as untrusted provenance.

ImportedComment.description: Verified imported comment. origin is fixed to import; sourceAuthor is optional untrusted provenance and cannot identify an actor.

CommentOrigin.description: The only trusted origin for the imported comment shape.

SourceAuthor.description: Normalized untrusted source author provenance: trim Unicode White_Space, reject Unicode Cc and Cf controls, and count at most 256 Unicode scalar values. Empty after trimming is omitted.

hash_namespaces.description: Sorted exact source namespace inventory; each namespace is separate from the root hash token.

SourceAllocatorProvenance.description: Immutable source allocator declaration retained exactly as provenance in the restore receipt and project metadata key plug.restore.sourceAllocator. Hash declarations accept hash_length 1..64; sequential declarations preserve hash_length 0..64. It is never interpreted as the live target allocator.

TargetRandomAllocator.description: Explicit live Plug allocator. A 16-byte candidate is rendered as 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters; top-level IDs are prefix-random and direct child IDs are parent-random.

RestoreAllocatorProfile.description: The source provenance and live target allocator are separate values and are persisted/recovered together. targetAllocator.prefix must equal sourceAllocator.prefix; a mismatch refuses before staging.

scope.description: Normalized G4 AgentLabel is empty for authenticated actors.
Normalized G4 AgentLabel for anonymous-local mode; empty is allowed.

RestoreImportAdmission.description: Host-private trusted admission. Authenticated mode binds an interactive user, restore-admin authorization and operation/archive D32; anonymous-local mode records trusted human presence and an honest anonymous actor/agent scope. A JSON principal, archive field, lease or digest cannot mint this admission.

historyMode.description: Archive history policy. Omitted input is strict full history; partial and snapshot are explicit opt-ins.

RestoreImportProfile.description: Transaction-local prepared import profile. The trusted host creates it after admission; ordinary JSON-RPC callers cannot submit or forge it.

CloseOp.description: Enter the close slot or an explicit declared successful terminal status at this operation position in tx.apply; reuse bead.close guards, permission, reason and provenance. Any refusal rolls back the whole ChangeSet. No force or generic status shortcut.

expect.description: Preconditions against the ordered in-request image before this close. Revision guards refuse a record written earlier in this request. ChangeSet.expect keeps its pinned-snapshot semantics.

targetStatus.description: Exact declared successful terminal status for this project/type; omission selects the close slot. All transition, permission, graph and child guards remain in force. Active workflow providers that cannot honor the selector refuse it.

nativeExtensions.description: Opaque native field JSON token text, preserved byte-exact. Absent keys retain prior values; null is the token string null. These values have no scheduling or thread semantics.

CycleMember.description: One member in directed cycle order; an unreadable member discloses no reference.

Cycle.description: A path rotated to its lowest internal ID; the closing endpoint is implied.

CyclesResult.description: Current durable-plane cycles anchored by a readable member in the selected project. Wholly hidden cycles contribute no items or count.

LinkTargetKind.description: Omission is local. Explicit external targets retain an exact nonempty branch-zero ID and are never resolved against local beads.

TargetHashAllocator.description: Live Beads adaptive base36 hash policy, with ten nonce attempts per length through the configured maximum and monotonic parent.N child counters. Source IDs remain unchanged.

AsOfSelector.description: Input selector: exactly one revision address or RFC3339 instant. An instant resolves to the highest committed revision at or before it in one complete pinned changeset snapshot; returned addresses remain concrete revisions. Incomplete retained history refuses history_gone. Current read permission applies.

instant.description: RFC3339 instant, with optional nanosecond precision and offset.

AuthzLinkAllowNotLast.message: authorization link allowed before the end of the chain

IdempotencyKeyReused.message: idempotency key reused with different parameters

OntologyUseSlotVerb.message: status transition requires its slot verb

LockoutRefused.message: change would lock out the applier

PluginHostWriteInSyncCall.message: plugin host write in synchronous call

InvalidCursor.message: cursor does not belong to this request

info.title: Plug JSON-RPC contract
info.description: Canonical tagged JSON-RPC v1 contract snapshot for Plug. Go and OpenRPC share the operation, event, cursor, and error encodings; source provenance and an independently checked method registry are recorded in this document.
